title: Meridian Health Tower V3 Candidate Preview Pack
pii_phi_handling: Synthetic, PHI-free, planning-grade healthcare demo context. No patient, member, provider, claim-line, PHI, PII, or real production Meridian records are included. Candidate preview remains inactive until quality gate and human promotion approval pass.
notes: Manifest gates a candidate-preview-only Tower load path from Meridian v3 dimensions 08, 09, 11, 14, 17, and 18. It does not update Active Tenant Access, promote a candidate, make Tower read candidate data by default, or authorize realized-value claims.
